title: Thomas Sowell Discusses The Trump Tariffs | Uncommon Knowledge | Full Interview on April 15, 2025
summary: Thomas Sowell (April 2025): a worldwide trade war repeats the 1930s mistake, and rule-changing uncertainty makes people hoard cash, which is tolerable only if tariffs are brief bargaining tools.

assertions.quote: everybody loses because everybody follows suit and all that happens is that you get a great reduction in international trade.

verdicts.note: Retaliatory tariff rounds in the 1930s and 2018-2019 cut trade volumes and produced net losses for both sides in the studies that measured them.

assertions.quote: that is the formula for having people s hang on to their money until they figure out what you're going to do.
So if this is just a set of shortrun PS for various various uh limited uh objectives limited in time, fine maybe.

verdicts.note: Prolonged protection compounds the losses, but 2018-2019 studies found trade-policy uncertainty itself cut investment even when tariffs were short-lived or merely threatened.
